map.name: Karth Vael
map.setting: a castle town with a garrison
map.trouble: Skorn, the Troll King of Mount Dreg, sends his trolls against the garrison of Karth Vael; Marshal Hesk sent the player to Commander Ostrag to stop him.

guard_bark.specifics: Hulm, a guard at the north gate of Karth Vael; later, once Grolm is dead.

first.speaker: Hulm
first.text: Hey, you ought to get a proper cloak.

again.speaker: Hulm
again.text: Wanna try the stocks for size?

later.speaker: Hulm
later.text: Commander Ostrag, here is the stranger who finished off Grolm and now seeks to serve the garrison!

bounty_offer.specifics: Commander Ostrag wants Grolm, the Troll chief who raided the Granary Yard, dead in the Troll Den on Mount Dreg.

offer.speaker: Ostrag
offer.text:
Blast! Where were you, lad!? The Trolls stormed the Granary Yard and we'd have lost the winter stores to them if Dorrik's pikemen had not charged in at the last moment!

But in the confusion, their chief Grolm got away with a dozen of our war-horses, leaving the burnt stores our smallest worry! All of Karth Vael is now at risk if Grolm lives!

You must follow his trail, northeast to the Troll Den on Mount Dreg! Kill Grolm or we are doomed!

reminder.speaker: Ostrag
reminder.text: I'm sure Grolm is still out there! Go quickly!

completion.speaker: Ostrag
completion.text:
In calmer times, the barracks of Karth Vael would ring with cheers for the death of Grolm! Well done! But now we must stop the Troll King Skorn once and for all.

Please accept these with our deepest thanks for your fine work!

journal.text: Go to the Troll Den and kill Grolm.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Odlin lost his fur cloak to an imp in the loft above the kennels, and the hounds now bite anyone who enters the yard.

offer.speaker: Odlin
offer.text:
Good! My family keeps the finest hounds in Karth Vael. Unfortunately, a nasty little imp has moved into the loft above our kennel and run off with my fur cloak. He has stirred up the hounds and now they snap at anyone who enters the yard.

Go get the cloak back from the imp, and I'll make it worth your while. Will you go?

Here, take this whistle, it will calm the hounds.

refusal.speaker: Odlin
refusal.text:
Too bad, nobody else will go near that yard.

Come and find me if you think better of it, I'm at the kennels by the stables.

reminder.speaker: Odlin
reminder.text: Don't fret, one little imp is no match for you. Come back with my cloak.

completion.speaker: Odlin
completion.text:
Excellent! You've got my cloak back.

Here is your reward. The red potion will put you back on your feet. Good luck!

after.speaker: Odlin
after.text: Thanks again for getting my cloak back.

journal.text: Retrieve Odlin's fur cloak from the Imp in the kennel loft.

journal_done.text: NOTE: Odlin has his cloak back and the hounds are quiet.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk of Karth Vael: Nessa asks about the pass, Crull gossips about the Troll King, Tam brushes the player off.

rumour1.speaker: Nessa
rumour1.text: Hello again. Has the Troll King been stopped, yet?

rumour2.speaker: Crull
rumour2.text: I hear that the Troll King has finally lost his patience. He's massing an army below Mount Dreg! Everyone must watch out for Troll scouts!

rumour3.speaker: Tam
rumour3.text: I've been told to keep away from newcomers.

shop_greeting.specifics: Gorlick keeps the inn, Zibbet the arms shop, Vexel the magic shop in Karth Vael.

inn.speaker: Gorlick
inn.text: Are you here to join the garrison?

arms.speaker: Zibbet
arms.text: You'd better be quick the garrison's buying up all my steel.

magic.speaker: Vexel
magic.text: Yes, what is it, stranger? I'm rather occupied.

two_givers.specifics: Sergeant Dorrik demands written clearance to enter the Keep; Zibbet the smith offers to speak for the player if wasps are cleared from his coal store.

offer_a.speaker: Dorrik
offer_a.text: I am the Gate Sergeant of Karth Vael. If you wish to enter the Keep you'll need written clearance.

offer_b.speaker: Zibbet
offer_b.text:
Hello. I am Zibbet, Master Smith of Karth Vael. The Keep is strict and Sergeant Dorrik is the worst of it.

Here's the deal, do me a favor and I'll have a word with him for you. Interested?

outcome_a.speaker: Zibbet
outcome_a.text:
Good! My forge sits at the bottom of the Keep stair. Unfortunately, a swarm of giant wasps has moved into the coal store next door. They have stung my apprentices and now nobody will fetch the coal.

Go kill the wasps and I'll speak to Sergeant Dorrik once you're back.

Here, take this iron key, it will open the coal store.

outcome_b.speaker: Zibbet
outcome_b.text:
Pity, I doubt anyone else will vouch for you.

Should you change your mind, I'll be at my forge below the Keep stair.

journal_a.text: Find someone to speak for you with Sergeant Dorrik.

journal_b.text: Kill the wasps in Zibbet's coal store.

rescue.specifics: Brindle, the garrison cook, is trapped in the Grain Vault below the Keep when the portcullis jams; Hulm begs the player to go and find her.

plea.speaker: Hulm
plea.text:
While you were out on the north road, the portcullis jammed -- trapping Brindle in the Grain Vault deep below the Keep! Ostrag is worried for our cook.

We had best go down under the Keep and find Brindle.

reminder.speaker: Hulm
reminder.text: Why are you standing about? We must hurry to the cellar stair! Brindle may be in real danger!

found.speaker: Brindle
found.text:
Hey, it's you! You got past the portcullis!

There are huge rats out there. I had to bar myself in while I was counting sacks.

Here, take this key and unlock the gate behind you.

following.speaker: Brindle
following.text: Thanks again. I believe there are spare torches in that crate. Quick, follow me! I know a back stair up to the kitchens!

completion.speaker: Dorrik
completion.text: Praise be, you're both alive! You'll make a fine pikeman, lad. Ostrag will be glad you brought his cook back in one piece.

journal.text: Rescue Brindle from the Grain Vault below the Keep.

main_opening.specifics: Joss points the player to Commander Ostrag, who sends him to Pemmick in Orm against the Troll King Skorn of Mount Dreg.

opening.speaker: Ostrag
opening.text:
I'll go no further. Too many Troll eyes the closer we get to Mount Dreg.

Follow the river path to Orm.

Find my old comrade Pemmick. He'll lend you a hand if he can.

Stay on the path. Cliff beasts will bite hard should you stray. Watch yourself out there, lad.

reminder.speaker: Ostrag
reminder.text: Go on! Don't stand around gawking. Look lively.

journal.text: Find Pemmick's hut in the Village of Orm.
